features.text: Sleek Design
The sleek design of this microwave with glass touch controls, Electrolux signature pinstripe design and stainless steel trim kit looks beautiful in any kitchen
Convection Cooking
Bake and brown your favorite foods with Convection Cooking, the convenience of a microwave and the performance of an oven.
Preheat/Keep Warm Mode
Making delicious meals is more effortless with preheat/keep warm mode which allows you to preheat before cooking or keep food warm while you finish the rest of the meal.
Convenient Quick Start Options
Get meals on the table in minutes with nine different Quick Start options that allow you to start cooking faster.
Premium LED Lighting
Keep your food clearly visible while it cooks with premium LED lighting
Combi Cooking
Get the best of both worlds with combi cooking which combines the speed of a microwave with the browning and crisping power of convection.
Safety Lock Function

Two step open safety function helps limit children from opening the microwave and spilling hot contents during and 30 minutes after cooking. You can choose to permanently deactivate the safety lock function.
Automatic Open & Zero-Clearance Hinge
This microwave's full glass door features effortless automatic open and space saving zero-clearance hinge.
Installation Trim Kit
For a stylish built-in look, purchase a 30" stainless steel trim kit. Trim kits are sold separately and required for installation.
Platinum Star® Limited Warranty
Our exclusive warranty offers peace of mind for registered owners with two years of coverage on replacement parts
